import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read()
t=t.replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x for r in inp for x in r))
h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0])
# find boxes: connected components of non-background(3)
seen=set();boxes=[]
for i in range(h):
    for j in range(w):
        if inp[i][j]!=3 and (i,j) not in seen:
            col=inp[i][j];stack=[(i,j)];comp=[]
            seen.add((i,j))
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop();comp.append((y,x))
                for dy in(-1,0,1):
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        a,b=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and inp[a][b]==col and (a,b) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a,b));stack.append((a,b))
            ys=[p[0] for p in comp];xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            boxes.append((col,min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs),len(comp)))
for b in boxes:
    col,r0,c0,r1,c1,n=b
    hh=r1-r0+1; ww=c1-c0+1
    interior=hh*ww-n
    # fill value used in output
    fills=set(out[i][j] for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1)) if hh>2 and ww>2 else set()
    print(b,'h,w',hh,ww,'interior',interior,'fills',fills)
